title: Test local restore cancellation after its retained destination is removed
outcome: A regression test proves that abandoning a bound local restore with no destination clears the active observation instead of reinstating its earlier completed occurrence.
acceptance: Create O1 completed, create a local pending O2 with an explicit predecessor binding, remove the destination store, abandon O2, and assert RestoreRecords::None while the kept O1 file remains unchanged.
The regression fails if the local abandonment policy always reinstates the predecessor; use deterministic fixtures without changing production restore behavior.
Focused tests pass and the normal repository review and landing requirements are met.
